source_name: Central Electricity Authority (Flexible Operation of Coal based Thermal Power Generating Units) Regulations, 2023, as summarised by India Environment Portal
source_location: Summary text: 'These units shall have flexible operation capability with minimum power level of 40 per cent'
notes: Applied to the coal fleet as a whole: hourly coal generation is at least 40 percent of the fleet's highest hourly generation. The same summary gives ramp rates of at least 3 percent per minute (70-100 percent) and 2 percent per minute (55-70 percent), which do not bind at hourly resolution.
